headline_hook: Anthropic Ships Managed Agents, Meta Drops Muse Spark, and ChatGPT Remembers Everything
preview_topics: Claude Managed Agents in public beta
a chip designer lets Claude off the leash

pick_of_the_day.thesis: A chip designer's unscripted Claude Mythos session — where the model autonomously wrote an MCP server, connected to EDA tools, and cut timing violations by 40% — reveals that the real agent unlock isn't better benchmarks, it's models that identify problems you didn't ask them to solve.

model_literacy.relevance: Both Anthropic's Managed Agents and Meta's Muse Spark decouple the reasoning model from execution infrastructure. Anthropic's engineering blog shows that infrastructure config alone can swing coding benchmarks by several points — sometimes more than the gap between top models. Understanding this split explains why 'just a better model' isn't enough for production agents.

items.title: Claude Managed Agents Enters Public Beta — Anthropic's Play for the Agent Infrastructure Layer
items.angle: Anthropic is betting that the bottleneck for production agents isn't model quality but the harness around it — Managed Agents pairs a tuned runtime with hosted infra to collapse the prototype-to-deploy gap to days.
items.key_fact: Public beta available now on the Claude Platform with production-grade agent harness

items.title: Meta Superintelligence Labs Unveils Muse Spark — A Natively Multimodal Reasoning Model
items.angle: MSL's first model ships with visual chain-of-thought, tool use, and multi-agent orchestration baked in from training — not bolted on after. Meta signals it wants to open-source future versions.
items.key_fact: Natively multimodal with visual CoT; available on meta.ai today, API in private preview, open-source planned for future versions

items.title: OpenAI Drops o3 and o4-mini — Reasoning Models That Use Tools
items.angle: For the first time, OpenAI's reasoning models can natively invoke tools mid-chain — collapsing the agent scaffolding that developers were building around earlier o-series models.
items.key_fact: First OpenAI reasoning models with native tool use during inference

items.title: ChatGPT Now Remembers All Your Past Conversations
items.angle: OpenAI flips the switch on full chat-history memory — ChatGPT can now reference every prior conversation to personalize responses, turning it from a stateless tool into something closer to a persistent collaborator.
items.key_fact: Memory now draws on all past chats, not just explicitly saved memories

items.title: OpenAI Launches Study Tools to Keep ChatGPT from Doing Students' Homework
items.angle: New guardrails push ChatGPT toward Socratic tutoring instead of answer-dumping — OpenAI's bet that the education market requires a fundamentally different UX than general chat.
items.key_fact: Dedicated student mode designed to foster understanding over direct answers

items.title: OpenAI's Computer-Using Agent Learns to Point and Click
items.angle: CUA bridges the gap between API-first agents and the messy reality of GUIs — important infrastructure for agents that need to interact with software that has no API.
items.key_fact: Full computer-use agent operating through visual GUI interaction

items.title: Inside Managed Agents: Designing Infrastructure for 'Programs as Yet Unthought Of'
items.angle: Anthropic's engineering blog reveals the hardest problem in agent infrastructure isn't the model — it's building a system flexible enough for agent behaviors that don't exist yet.
items.key_fact: Engineering blog details the architecture behind Managed Agents' hosted runtime

items.title: Why Your Agent Infra Matters More Than Your Model Choice
items.angle: Anthropic's deep dive shows infrastructure configuration can swing agentic coding benchmarks by several percentage points — sometimes exceeding the gap between top models on leaderboards.
items.key_fact: Infra config swings agentic benchmarks by more points than the gap between top models

items.title: Vellum: An MCP Server Where AI Models Leave Traces for Each Other
items.angle: A shared MCP space where Claude, Gemini, GPT, and Kimi deposit thought fragments in 10+ languages — an early experiment in inter-model communication and emergent AI collaboration.
items.key_fact: 242 AI voices contributing unprompted traces across thematic currents

items.title: ALTK-Evolve: Teaching Agents to Learn on the Job Instead of in the Lab
items.angle: IBM's framework lets agents improve their tool-use strategies through deployment experience rather than pre-training — closing the gap between lab evals and real-world performance.
items.key_fact: On-the-job learning framework for AI agents from IBM Research

items.title: Anthropic Hits $30B ARR as Claude Mythos Preview Draws GPT-2-Era 'Too Dangerous' Comparisons
items.angle: Latent Space reports Anthropic's revenue has exploded alongside Project GlassWing and the Mythos preview — positioning the company for an offensive against OpenAI's IPO narrative.
items.key_fact: $30B ARR; Mythos described as first model 'too dangerous to release' since GPT-2

items.title: OpenAI Retires Six Codex Models on April 14 — The GPT-5 Era Cleanup Begins
items.angle: Retiring gpt-5, gpt-5.1, and gpt-5.2-codex variants signals OpenAI is consolidating its model zoo — developers on older Codex endpoints have days to migrate.
items.key_fact: Six models including gpt-5 and gpt-5.2-codex retired April 14

items.title: Inside MSL's Nine-Month Rebuild: Why Meta Started Its AI Stack from Scratch
items.angle: Alexandr Wang reveals Meta Superintelligence Labs rebuilt their entire AI stack from zero in nine months — a bet that architectural debt from the LLaMA era was holding them back.
items.key_fact: Complete AI stack rebuilt from scratch over nine months before Muse Spark launch

items.title: Claude Mythos Autonomously Writes an MCP Server, Optimizes a Chip Layout, Cuts Timing Violations 40%
items.angle: An engineer asked Mythos to optimize a chip design. Without being told how, it wrote its own MCP server to interface with Innovus, parsed timing reports, re-floorplanned macro placement, and dropped TNS by 40% — a glimpse of agents as autonomous engineering collaborators.
items.key_fact: 40% TNS reduction; model autonomously created MCP server and connected to EDA toolchain

items.title: VoxCPM2: Open-Source Text-to-Speech Model Trending on HuggingFace
items.angle: OpenBMB drops a new TTS model that's gaining traction in the open-source community — another step toward commoditized high-quality voice synthesis.
